name: copy
description: Two overlapping rounded pages with a distinct foreground sheet.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested greater separation and the standard Camera/Folder main-body corner roundness. Both page centerlines use radius 3.25 with unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke and .85 round caps. Nominal rear page centerline bounds are 2.85..15.45; front page centerline bounds are 8.55..21.15 on both axes. The offset is 5.70, producing a 4.00-unit clear straight gap between the exposed parallel borders (previously 2.80). Combined visible bounds are 2..22 on both axes, with balanced 2px artboard margins. The owner requested breaks at both rear/front junctions. The rear path now starts at 5.85 15.44037035 and ends at 15.44037035 5.85, trimmed along the existing corner arcs so each radius-.85 end cap stops exactly 1 unit before the visible foreground border. These two endpoint clearances are separate from the 4-unit parallel-border gap. The front page stays unchanged. Filled uses the exact Outline exterior: outer corner radius 4.10, rear-band inner radius 2.40 and .85 end caps. Its front page is solid, with no added enclosing box or artificial hole. Position and visible exterior match between styles at native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
